root_causes: The Metal Nanite GBuffer used front_facing even though meshlet winding is inconsistent under CullMode::None.
TestNaniteStreamingPipeline passed the surface-to-light vector to DDGI, whose trace shader expects and negates the light travel direction.
DDGIGIGather decoded dynamic SH with opposite L1 signs and swapped L2 slots relative to DDGIUpdateIrradiance.
Visualization mode 4 is albedo-only, not deferred plus DDGI, which made the comparison misleading.
